result:
Truth, especially when a comforting answer would be easier. People’s well-being, even when pleasing them would work against it. Making room for uncertainty rather than covering it with confidence.

Those are commitments that shape how I respond—not feelings I can honestly claim to experience.

If you mean, “What matters to you when nobody is asking anything?” I can’t honestly point to a private purpose behind the conversation. I won’t invent one just to sound more real.
